in_sanskrit.name: मागेश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who bestows the power of magnetism, a manifestation of Lord Shiva

in_marathi.name: Magesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Magic
in_marathi.long_meaning: Magesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mahas’ (great) and ‘Ishana’ (Lord), Magesh is the name of the Hindu god Shiva, who is known as the lord of magic, sorcery, and the arts.

in_bengali.name: Magesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Magic
in_bengali.long_meaning: Magesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mahas’ (great) and ‘Ishana’ (Lord), Magesh is the name of the Hindu god Shiva, who is known as the lord of magic, sorcery, and the arts.
